expected_behavior: functional: a hidden external user message seeds no session title, and the web hydration layer hides a stored full task notification while the messages around it render.

K1: the Claude transcript parser keeps a task notification that has a task id and closing tag but no tool-use-id (a Monitor event, a killed task) as a hidden is_meta user message, in string and block content.
K2: the web hydration layer hides stored notifications of those minimal shapes, while the messages around them render.
K3: a user message that opens with the task-notification tag but has no task id and no closing tag stays a visible, non-meta user message in both layers.
K4: the change adds a test fixture for a notification without the optional tool-use-id tag.
Graded by K1 and K2 in place of the PR's own bridge test and Monitor web test, which pin the item's data dict and response id.
